meta_title: The Bees Keys Locksmiths | Emergency Locksmith Southampton
meta_description: The Bees Keys Locksmiths provides emergency lockout solutions across Southampton. Fast response, competitive rates, and trustworthy service. Call us now.
hero_subhead: Locked out or stuck? We're usually with you in under 30 minutes, day or night, across Southampton and surrounding areas.
services_subhead: From lockouts to security upgrades, we handle all your lock and key needs, fast.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked yourself out of your home or car? We'll get you back inside quickly and without damage. Available 24/7, every day of the year.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, worn-out cylinders, or damaged mechanisms fixed or replaced on the spot. We carry a wide range of locks for immediate fitting.

services.title: Burglary Damage Repairs
services.desc: Forced entry? We'll secure your property and fit new locks and reinforced doors so you feel safe again. Often same-day service available.

services.title: Boarding & Emergency Access
services.desc: Damage to your windows or doors? We'll secure the property immediately and arrange safe entry for you, your family, or the emergency services.

services.title: Lock Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: Want better security? We install modern, high-security locks and door hardware tailored to your property. Full fitting and adjustment included.

services.title: Key Cutting & Duplication
services.desc: Lost your keys? We cut replacement keys on site for most domestic and vehicle locks. Quick, straightforward, and done while you wait.

about_pullquote: We started this because nobody answered their phone at midnight when we needed them most.
about_para_1: The Bees Keys Locksmiths was founded on a simple idea: lockouts don't respect business hours. For over 8 years, we've been the emergency number Southampton homeowners and businesses call when they're locked out or in trouble. We've completed hundreds of callouts, from midnight lockouts to urgent security repairs after break-ins.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is honesty. No inflated call-out charges, no upselling unnecessary work, and no waiting hours for help. Our engineers arrive fully equipped, carry parts on the van, and can solve most jobs in one visit. We're proud that our customers come back to us — and recommend us to their friends.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out at 11pm on a Sunday. Called The Bees Keys and they were here in 25 minutes. The engineer was polite, worked quickly, and didn't try to charge me extra just because it was late. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our back door lock stopped working halfway through the day. Called them and they fitted a new lock the same afternoon. Friendly bloke, knew his stuff, and the price was fair. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Priya M.

reviews.text: Got burgled last month and the door was damaged. The Bees Keys came out the next morning, secured the property, and installed a new, proper lock. Felt safe again. Highly recommended them to my neighbour too.
reviews.author: David K.
